v.t: Would to God ye could bear with me a little in my folly: and indeed bear with me.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with him.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been throughly made manifest among you in all things.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that ye might be exalted, because I have preached to you the gospel of God freely?

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and so will I keep myself.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: Wherefore? because I love you not? God knoweth.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: For ye suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take of you, if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: In journeyings often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by mine own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: Beside those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is offended, and I burn not?

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).
